descriptionChirho: A proper noun meaning 'house of the sun,' denoting the Levitical city in the territory of Judah near the Philistine border, notably where the Ark of the Covenant was returned (1 Samuel 6). All occurrences — bare nominative, with conjunctions, or with prepositions (in/at Beth-Shemesh) — refer to the same geographic location. Multilingual evidence confirms a single referent: eng 'Beth-Shemesh', spa 'Bet-Semes', hin 'बैत शेमेश', arb 'بَيْت شَمْس', kor '벳세메시', swa 'Beth-shemeshi'.
